summary: OceanaGold Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of Annual General and Special Meeting and Management Information Circular for the 2026 meeting. The filing covers routine items: receiving audited financials, electing directors, reappointing auditors, an advisory vote on executive compensation, and approval of a virtual-only meeting format. No special-situation transaction (merger, tender, spin-off, restructuring, etc.) is described. This is an ordinary annual meeting notice circular, not a special-situation event.
